## Overview

I practiced control flow, custom functions, and function mapping in R to reduce repetition and build more reusable analysis workflows.

The work connected basic programming concepts to analytics productivity. When analysis tasks repeat across years, countries, groups, or variables, functions make the work easier to scale and easier to check.

## Skills Demonstrated

- Writing `if` and `else if` logic.
- Creating loops and custom functions.
- Using `apply`, `lapply`, and `sapply`.
- Using `purrr::map` for repeated analysis.
- Building reusable plotting functions.

## Reflection

The main lesson was that functions help turn repeated code into a clear workflow. This supports scalable reporting, automated dashboards, and cleaner analysis projects.

Functional programming also supports Quarto reporting because reusable functions can power repeated charts, parameterized reports, and automated summaries.
